Calibration from eight questions is weak

next_minimal_probe.first_step: Freeze one post-first-tool state per original train question; use prepared first train8 as functional smoke only.
branches: Frozen action head plus generated arguments continuation
Native first action selector plus aligned execution, if functional parity permits
Up to two alternate legal primitive actions followed by frozen primary
next_minimal_probe.after_initial_action_continuation: Frozen primary for all branches; no copied teacher future suffix
next_minimal_probe.cost_matched_baseline: Native and primary at fixed remaining primitive-call budgets B=0,1,2, with separately generated intermediate answers; compare realized-cost Pareto as well as equal maximum budgets.
next_minimal_probe.native_first_token_caveat: Three tools share initial <tool_call>; exact native first token is not a 4-way action score. Decode/score to a distinguishing native action branch and count all costs; A/B/C/D prompt is a changed-prompt baseline.
next_minimal_probe.gate_limitations: Operational pilot criteria, not significance/noninferiority thresholds. Oracle uses privileged outcome labels. All-zero wrong answers do not count as positive compression evidence. Insufficient correct cases is inconclusive, not automatic data expansion.
stop_or_redirect: Insufficient oracle headroom: do not train compression head on same short-horizon data
FINAL-only benefit: early-stopping direction and Stop-RAG/utility baselines
No nonterminal shortcut benefit: do not call result trajectory transition distillation
Only implementation savings: report system optimization separately from learned-policy effect
Cost direction unclear or budget exhausted: report incomplete/uncertain, do not claim pass

diffusion_analogy.useful: Fewer sequential computations can imitate a teacher outcome.
diffusion_analogy.limit: RAG actions acquire new external observations. Training labels may use the future, but inference features and arguments must not. Macro execution may reduce decisions while preserving primitive calls.
